dev.title: Dev Tools
dev.lead: Utilities I use day to day. Everything runs in your browser — nothing is sent to any server.
dev.disclaimer: Generated numbers are fictitious and meant only for testing and development. Do not use them for fraudulent purposes.
cpf.title: CPF generator
cpf.desc: Random CPFs with valid check digits. For testing only.
cnpj.title: CNPJ generator
cnpj.desc: Random CNPJs with valid check digits, in the numeric or the new alphanumeric format. For testing only.
val.title: CPF/CNPJ validator
val.desc: Paste a CPF or CNPJ (numeric or alphanumeric) and check whether the check digits match.
uuid.title: UUID generator
uuid.desc: v4 (random) or v7 (time-ordered, great for primary keys) UUIDs.
pw.title: Password generator
pw.desc: Random passwords generated with the browser's cryptographic API.
json.title: JSON formatter
json.desc: Validates, formats and minifies JSON, pointing out where the error is.
b64.title: Base64 / URL
b64.desc: Encodes and decodes text as Base64, Base64URL or URL (percent-encoding), UTF-8 aware.
re.title: Regex tester
re.desc: Test (JavaScript) regular expressions with highlighted matches and capture groups.
jwt.title: JWT decoder
jwt.desc: Reads the header and payload of a JWT. The signature is not verified.
hash.title: MD5 / SHA hash
hash.desc: Computes MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 of the typed text (UTF-8).
hash.note: MD5 and SHA-1 are not safe for passwords or signatures; use them only for checksums and compatibility.
ts.title: Unix timestamp
ts.desc: Converts Unix timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) to dates and back.
